findings.obligation: L2 pcscd stopped on every exit (trap on EXIT/INT/TERM)
findings.observation: Non-blocking: only normal exits (no key, no reader, success, failed file) are driven; a signal path (TERM during the reader wait) is not, so a trap on EXIT only vs INT/TERM is not distinguished. Design promises SIGKILL is covered by stale-pcscd, not signals.
findings.remediation: Optional: add one case sending TERM to the script during reader wait and asserting pcscd stopped. Not required for craft.
